name: ownCloud Infinite Scale
description: ownCloud Infinite Scale (oCIS) is the current ownCloud server, a single Go binary with a built-in web UI. This VM runs the official owncloud/ocis container on a Debian or Ubuntu cloud image with Docker and works on a plain IP address straight away.

notes.text: Default settings use Debian 13; Advanced settings offer other Debian/Ubuntu cloud images. The container is started by the owncloud-ocis.service first-boot unit (log: /var/log/owncloud-ocis.log); if Docker cannot be pre-installed, install-docker.service runs first. The admin password is generated (or taken from VM_OCIS_ADMIN_PASSWORD), shown at the end and saved to /tmp/<hostname>-<VMID>-ocis-credentials.txt on the Proxmox host.

oCIS is published on https://<VM-IP>:9200 with a self-signed certificate and all links use the IP the VM has on first boot. Reserve the DHCP lease, or put a reverse proxy with a domain in front and set OCIS_URL in the container accordingly.
For classic ownCloud 10 use the TurnKey-based owncloud-vm instead.
If you use Cloud-init, checkout cloud-init discussion: `https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/discussions/272`
